subject.title: fix(reef): add timeout and bounded JSON reads to relay transport

question: Should every Reef relay HTTP request fail after a fixed 15-second response-header deadline?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically sound, but repository evidence does not define the Reef relay latency/SLA contract; choosing the permanent deadline determines whether slow existing relays remain supported.

options.title: Approve 15 seconds
options.body: Accept the tested fixed deadline as the Reef relay contract and merge after exact-head checks complete.

options.title: Choose another fixed deadline
options.body: Set an owner-approved value that matches expected relay latency, then rerun the focused and controlled-relay proof.

options.title: Pause for relay requirements
options.body: Hold the PR until Reef deployment latency expectations are known if maintainers cannot safely choose a fixed value yet.

recommendation.title: Approve 15 seconds
recommendation.body: Accept the tested fixed deadline as the Reef relay contract and merge after exact-head checks complete.

likelyOwner.reason: They most recently changed and proved the same Reef relay request boundary on current main.
